_doc: The sounds the game plays (openspec/changes/sound-effects, design section 3): per cue its file (a committed OGG under assets/audio, built by tools/audio/render_sfx.sh), the bus it plays on (Master, Music or Effects, set by the Options sheet's boxes: src/Game/Ui/AudioSettings.cs) and its level in dB at that bus. The console keys first (owner, 2026-11-07: "Console keys - this should be implemented in the game"): each skin names its key cue in its style (src/Game/Ui/Kit/*Kit.cs, SkinStyle.KeySound); and the bridge bed under a battle (owner, 2026-11-07: "use amb_bridge_brown", "put in game now"; src/Game/Ui/ConsoleSounds.cs). The battle's sounds (owner, 2026-11-10: "Implement sound fx in the game"): which event plays which cue is data/audio/events.json (SoundMap); a placed cue plays at its ship in 3D and falls off with distance. Levels set so a sound nearby peaks about 10 dB under full scale at the Options sheet's first volumes (Master and Effects 8 of 10), the frequent ones (point defence, shield hits) lower; the bridge bed sits about 30 dB down (owner, 2026-11-10: "I don't hear any clicks or bridge hums": the bed and the keys were set 20 dB quieter than this and could not be heard). A cue may name several takes (files in place of file): each time it plays, one is picked at random, so a sound heard often is not the same every time (the shield hit's three low thumps; owner, 2026-11-11: "we can use them all to give the.sound variety").
